name: Partial Cubes Are Closed under Projecting Common-Section Gluing
statement: Let partial-cube pieces $A_i\subseteq\{0,1\}^{E\sqcup F_i}$ have disjoint private coordinate blocks, contain the same nonempty zero section $D$, and project onto exactly $D$ in the shared coordinates. Their embedded union is a partial cube.
proof: Within one piece its isometric paths remain available. Between points in different pieces, travel from each endpoint to its Hamming gate in $D$ and join the two gates by a shortest path in $D$. Private supports lie in disjoint coordinate blocks and the shared segment realizes exactly the remaining shared-coordinate disagreement, so the concatenated length equals the ambient Hamming distance.
